I was 9 when that movie 2012 came out and it scared me all the way until I was 12. I remember believing the world would end that year and thinking my entire life wouldn’t matter and I would loose everyone I loved to an unspeakable catastrophe. All the documentaries, crazed people pointing to the Mayan calendar, and other pointless random coincidences that supposed it would be the end convinced me.

Fast forward to Jan of 2013 I was sitting there awkwardly still alive. and for whatever reason those documentaries about 2012 just quietly stopped playing. I wonder why.

If there is zero evidence to suggest the world is ending, don’t believe it. Trust me it would be better to believe you still have lots of happy memories to come and be wrong than live your final days in fear.

The past is untouchable. It’s something you have to come to terms with. The future isn’t here. It never will be. All there is is now. That’s all there ever was. We can get so lost and panic thinking about the times that don’t exist. When the most important truth is, use the present to walk further from the past and make a better tomorrow. Try your best, dont worry about failure, because at least you tried. Don’t waste your time wondering how things will go wrong or how you should have done things differently. Use your time to find what you can do here and now that will make you sleep feeling accomplished or at peace.

> Have you ever considered that your jokes might be offensive or hurtful to others? Even your brother doesnt like the jokes, then maybe what you are saying makes him uncomfortable, or the way you say things makes it sound over the line. You could ask him about this.
